$comment: Upstream repositories gathered into the AI Agent Office library. `npm run sync` clones/updates them into .sources/ (sparse checkouts where `sparse` is set) and `npm run build:library` regenerates library/ and public/data/. `scan` rules replace the default agents/skills/commands walk for repos with their own layout.

sources.label: Claude Code Best Practice
sources.role: Academy: Claude Code best practices, workflows, example agents, skills and commands

sources.label: Claude Skills (alirezarezvani)
sources.role: The big skill & persona library: engineering, product, marketing, C-level, compliance, finance

sources.label: Claude Office (W17ant)
sources.role: Original pixel-art office: Claude Code hook -> server -> live office visualisation idea

sources.label: Graphify
sources.role: Knowledge graph: every agent, skill and command gathered into one navigable graph; skills to build, query, update and export graphs

sources.label: Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
sources.role: Self-improving agent with a learning loop and a large skills catalogue

sources.label: ECC (Everything Claude Code)
sources.role: Production agent harness: language reviewers, build resolvers, commands, hooks and hundreds of skills

sources.label: AI Agents for Beginners (Microsoft)
sources.role: Academy course: 19 lessons on building AI agents — design patterns, tool use, agentic RAG, planning, multi-agent, protocols (MCP/A2A), context engineering, memory, security

sources.label: AI Agent Book (Bojie Li)
sources.role: Academy textbook: Agent = LLM + Context + Tools — context engineering, memory and knowledge, tools, evaluation, post-training, self-evolution, multi-agent collaboration

sources.label: Agent Skills (Addy Osmani)
sources.role: Production engineering skills for coding agents: interview-me, spec- and test-driven development, frontend UI, performance, security, shipping; plus reviewer/auditor agents and commands

sources.label: 500+ AI Agent Projects
sources.role: 21 runnable agents (web research, code review, SQL, email, support…) and a catalogue of industry use cases by framework (CrewAI, AutoGen, Agno, LangGraph), one entry per project

sources.label: Pi Agent Harness (Earendil)
sources.role: Self-extensible coding agent: scout/planner/worker/reviewer subagents, prompt templates, skills and docs on how an agent harness works

sources.label: Agent Reach
sources.role: Internet access for agents: search and read the web, Twitter/X, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, LinkedIn, RSS and more (16 platforms)

describe.reach-search: Agent Reach: semantic web search (Exa) and search tools — find sources on any topic before reading them.
describe.reach-social: Agent Reach: read social media and communities — Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook, Instagram, XiaoHongShu, Bilibili, V2EX.
describe.reach-video: Agent Reach: videos and podcasts — YouTube and Bilibili subtitles/transcripts, podcast transcription.
describe.reach-web: Agent Reach: read any web page or RSS feed as clean text (Jina Reader and fallbacks).
describe.reach-dev: Agent Reach: developer sources — GitHub repos, issues, PRs and code search through the gh CLI.
describe.reach-career: Agent Reach: jobs and recruiting — LinkedIn and Boss Zhipin profiles and job listings.
describe.reach-finance: Agent Reach: market data — stock quotes and discussions (Xueqiu) for research.

describe.agent-reach-setup-exa: Set up Exa semantic search for Agent Reach (free, via MCP, no API key).
describe.agent-reach-setup-groq: Set up Groq Whisper so Agent Reach can transcribe videos and podcasts.
describe.agent-reach-setup-reddit: Set up Reddit access for Agent Reach.
describe.agent-reach-setup-twitter: Set up Twitter/X access for Agent Reach (cookies or backends).
describe.agent-reach-setup-xiaohongshu: Set up XiaoHongShu access for Agent Reach.

describe.agent-reach-troubleshooting: Troubleshooting Agent Reach channels (Xueqiu, Twitter, Reddit, YouTube and more).
describe.agent-reach-install: Install Agent Reach: one command for your agent, then `agent-reach doctor` checks every channel.
describe.agent-reach-update: Update Agent Reach to the latest version and re-check the channels.
describe.agent-reach-cookie-export: Export browser cookies to a server so Agent Reach can read login-only platforms.
